visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Squares of Primes Pass the Test
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 4 and 9 are not prime, but they appear in the list of primes up to 20.

solution.explanation: For a perfect square like 4 or 9 the only divisor to test is exactly the square root, and d * d equals n. A strict < never tries it, so the square of a prime looks prime.
